name: Khovanov Homology Constraint Canonical Sim
description: Euler characteristic constraint: χ(Kh(K)) = J_K(q). Graded ranks sum with sign (-1)^i to yield Jones polynomial coefficients.

pytorch.reason: pytorch not needed; pure symbolic/algebraic computation via cvc5 and sympy

pyg.reason: PyG message passing not needed; constraint geometry handled via SMT solver

z3.reason: z3 not needed; cvc5 handles all SMT constraint proofs in this sim

cvc5.reason: cvc5 SMT solver: load_bearing proof of Khovanov homology graded rank constraints

sympy.reason: sympy: supportive symbolic algebra for Jones polynomial formulas and coefficient extraction

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed; knot topology constraints only

geomstats.reason: geomstats not needed; constraints handled via SMT solver

e3nn.reason: e3nn not needed; no SO(3) equivariance required

rustworkx.reason: rustworkx not needed; no graph structure in this sim

xgi.reason: xgi not needed; pairwise interactions only

toponetx.reason: toponetx not needed; standard algebraic ops sufficient

gudhi.reason: gudhi not needed; no persistent homology in this sim

test_2_trefoil.name: Trefoil knot: alternating ranks yield χ = 1

test_3_sympy_unknot_jones.name: Sympy Jones polynomial unknot: J(q) has coeff 1 at q^0

test_3_rank_exceeds_crossing_bound.name: Rank exceeds crossing bound (should be UNSAT)

test_3_trefoil_coefficients.name: Trefoil Jones polynomial: coefficients at q^0 and q^4
